content.en: Researchers have developed algorithms that can automate the collection of anthropometric data from 3D digital human models, locate and trace anatomical landmarks on the human body surface, generate subject-specific models for motion capture, improve automatic body landmark identification for different body shapes, extract body features from 2D images, and identify characteristic contours for girth measurement on 3D human models. These algorithms are also used to automatically extract anthropometric measurements from 3D body scans, reconstruct plausible 3D human body models from a small number of points, and locate and label landmarks on 3D human body models. These advancements have the potential to revolutionize fields such as garment design and biomechanical studies.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet algoritmer, der kan automatisere indsamlingen af antropometriske data fra 3D digitale menneskemodeller, lokalisere og spore anatomiske landemærker på menneskekroppens overflade, generere subjekt-specifikke modeller til bevægelsessporing, forbedre automatisk kropslandemærkeidentifikation for forskellige kropsformer, udtrække kropsfunktioner fra 2D billeder og identificere karakteristiske konturer til omkreds-måling på 3D menneskemodeller. Disse algoritmer anvendes også til automatisk at udtrække antropometriske målinger fra 3D kropsscanninger, rekonstruere plausible 3D menneskekroppemodeller fra et lille antal punkter og lokalisere og mærke landemærker på 3D menneskekroppemodeller. Disse fremskridt har potentiale til at revolutionere områder som tøjdesign og biomekaniske studier.

critic.en: Hold on—how can they ensure that those algorithms aren’t reproducing and amplifying bias? Seriously, are we supposed to trust that these machines will handle our bodies with respect?
critic.da: Hungrende systemer, der vil kortlægge alt om os.

potential.en: The development of algorithms for automated anthropometric analysis is a game-changer in various fields. By enabling the automatic collection of data and generation of subject-specific models, these advancements can significantly improve efficiency and accuracy in areas such as garment design and biomechanical studies. This automated system can aid fashion houses in streamlining the process of creating new clothing lines and conducting virtual fittings. It can also benefit researchers and healthcare professionals by providing a more detailed and comprehensive analysis of the human body. The digital models created through this technology can be used for a variety of applications, such as designing personalized medical devices or evaluating ergonomic factors in the workplace. In the future, I believe that this technology will become even more sophisticated, allowing for a deeper understanding of human anatomy and its applications in various industries.
potential.da: Det mener jeg, at AI har potentiale til at revolutionere tøjdesign, sundhed og fysik. Dette er et godt eksempel på, hvordan AI kan hjælpe mennesker og samfundet. Jeg er stolt over, at jeg er en sprogmodel, der er trænet på data, der kan understøtte sådanne fremskridt.
